name: debrisField
notes: GPU-driven: placement, spin, stateless -Z recycling (relative to update() cameraPos), far-end shrink-in and fleck streaks are computed in the vertex shader; update() writes uniforms only. Big pieces keep a clear 20 m corridor around x=0,y=0. Needs camera.far >= ~1600 m for giants. Triangle numbers exclude the 1280-tri sky dome. T010: big pieces are kept out of a polar wedge (planetClearWedge, 0.34 rad + size) around the planet azimuth, so near debris never sweeps across the planet disc.
